title: Childhood fall from a garage roof softened by warmth

tellings.quote: one of the branches snapped and I fell and I fell like 25 ft.

plain: Dan Sherman, a former US Air Force sergeant who says the National Security Agency, the US government's code and signals intelligence agency, hired him to communicate with aliens, told podcast host Jesse Michels about a fall when he was in second grade. He says a branch snapped and he dropped about 25 feet near his family's garage roof, but felt a warmth that softened the landing, which he takes as an early sign that something was watching over him.
